inputs.model.prompt: Restyle @Video1 as an ultra-simple Blender solid-viewport playblast, almost everything made of primitive blocks. EVERY person or character MUST become a primitive-box mannequin: a perfect light-grey CUBE for the head, with a totally flat face of two small black square eyes, one small grey square nose, and a thin short black line for a mouth. No ears, no hair, no eyebrows, no real human face, no likeness of the original person. The body is ONE plain light-grey rectangular box, like a fridge standing on end — no clothing, no armor, no cape, no logos, no folds, no muscles, no costume colors. If arms or legs are needed they are only short grey boxes or cylinders with no hands, fingers, boots or detail. Any held prop becomes a simple grey or flat-colored box or cylinder. Environment: very simple untextured primitives with flat solid colors — big boxes for buildings, flat planes for ground and water, a flat sky, chunky untextured colored stand-ins for structures. No windows, no text, no textures, no photos, no reflections, no cinematic lighting. Keep the exact same camera move, framing, character positions, character count and timing as @Video1. Do not add new action.
